svg.title: Diffusion module workflow diagram
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the original workflow: input enters a conditioning trunk, sequence/pair representations and a point cloud feed a diffusion module, which iteratively denoises structure and sequence to produce intermediate and final protein results.

g.desc: Origin section: the word Input sits left of a rightward arrow leading into the conditioning trunk; the rounded trunk frame contains two centered text lines.
Inside the representation frame: two thin horizontal sequence embeddings sit above a square pair-representation grid; mathematical labels are left-aligned to the data blocks.
The cloud frame contains a dense multicolor residue point cloud centered above a peptide sequence; the red CDR label is directly below the highlighted X region.
The diffusion module is horizontally symmetric: a feature extractor feeds atom-level and residue-level representation boxes; those in turn connect to structure and sequence denoising boxes.
Intermediate result frame: a teal protein cartoon with red and yellow highlighted loop/sequence elements appears above a sequence label where XXTYX is emphasized; CDR label is red below.
Final result frame: a tan protein cartoon with a yellow highlighted CDR loop is shown above the final sequence CEVINTYWGQG, where INTY is highlighted yellow and CDR appears below in red.
